Question Choices: Find the inverse of 33 modulo 56. Give the integer from 0 to 55.
Hints: Find x such that 33x leaves remainder 1 when divided by 56.
Solution: Back-substitution gives 33*(17) + 56*(-10) = 1. Reduce 17 modulo 56 to get 17; 33*17 = 56*10 + 1.

Solution: Back-substitution gives 5*(-5) + 13*(2) = 1. Reduce -5 modulo 13 to get 8; 5*8 = 13*3 + 1.
